test_title: PYST 01: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 04 Feb, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All gabions are walls.

All concretes are walls.

All bridges are walls.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some bridges are gabions.

(II) Some concretes are bridges.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/566c9be0077645860f21a53dedcc70c3761636afdc95d36bb7fac8efc2d304d9.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some bridges are gabions → **Does not** follow (As all gabions are walls, all concretes are walls and all bridges are walls. So it is possible but not definite)

(II) Some concretes are bridges → Does not follow (As all concretes are walls and all bridges are walls. So it is possible but not definite)

∴ Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
